messages.subject: [IT] Document management system maintenance – Saturday 18 Oct
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The firm's DMS will be unavailable Saturday 18 October 06:00–10:00 BST for scheduled maintenance and a security patch. Please save and close any checked-out documents before Friday evening. Email and calendar are unaffected.

IT Helpdesk | Whitfield Carter LLP
